# Security policy

P4 Bot is an unofficial fork of the T3 Code source code and is not maintained by T3 Tools, Inc.
Report security vulnerabilities in P4 Bot privately through
[GitHub security advisories](https://github.com/pnll1991/p4-bot/security/advisories/new), not to T3 Tools.

Please do not disclose them publicly until we have had a reasonable opportunity to investigate and
remediate them. A vulnerability that also affects upstream T3 Code should be reported to T3 Tools
through their own policy as well.
